intent_rule: Apply the full literal; seed topic alone is insufficient. Preserve real flipping/investment, renovation/design/physical services, named-house ambiguity and genuine buyer/owner guides.

reason_definitions.EXPLICIT_GAMEPLAY: The complete literal explicitly requests a game, games, gameplay or play of the named franchise, rather than actual property purchase/renovation services. Preliminary unapproved EXACT proposal only; no game availability, feature or platform compatibility claim.
reason_definitions.EXPLICIT_GAME_PLATFORM: The complete literal has a console, computer/mobile platform, operating system or game-platform cue with the captured title wording. This supports digital entertainment intent; it does not prove that a compatible product exists or authorize broad platform-word exclusions.
reason_definitions.EXPLICIT_DIGITAL_PRODUCT: The complete literal explicitly requests downloading/installing the captured title or a digital product key. No underlying download legality, licence, safety, availability or provider relationship is inferred; actual property brochures/floor plans remain protected.
reason_definitions.CONFIRMED_GAME_TITLE_2: The exact House Flipper 2 game title or its title-specific product/release navigation is corroborated by the parent-observed official Steam reference. This does not establish a release date, platform support, price or feature. Aliases and token permutations remain unresolved.
reason_definitions.PROPERTY_DEMAND_OR_GUIDE_AMBIGUITY: The complete literal can describe real property flipping/investment, houses to buy, pricing/sale, renovation/design, physical services or client information. The seed topic does not remove that reading; HOLD.
reason_definitions.NAMED_HOUSE_OR_UNCORROBORATED_CONTENT: Named house, pet, garden, luxury, television, horror or character wording lacks a sufficient complete-literal game/platform/download cue or corroborated entity mapping. Preserve possible actual property or client-guide intent; HOLD.
reason_definitions.ENTITY_OR_VENDOR_NAVIGATION_UNRESOLVED: Entity/vendor/site/review/navigation wording is not independently resolved in this capture. No inherited game classification, provider affiliation, actual feature or service exclusion; HOLD.
reason_definitions.UNRESOLVED_ALIAS_SPELLING_LANGUAGE: Unspaced, malformed, abbreviated, language-sensitive or possible spelling/alias wording needs separate review. Original provider text stays unchanged; no corrected keyword is generated; HOLD.
reason_definitions.UNVERIFIED_NUMBER_VERSION_OR_PRODUCT: Unexplained sequel/version/date/numeric or generic simulator/product wording does not establish the specific game or exclude investment simulation/client guidance. No release/version/availability fact is inferred; HOLD.

variant_rule: All 87 equal-token groups and seven closed-string alias groups remain unresolved for distinct concepts/Google equivalence; actual source literals are not generated variants. Conditional semantic proposals are not admission-ready counts.
